requirement: Implement EPIC 1, Story 2: author drums and wrapped bass holds directly on a legible 64-step grid.

architecture.decision: Render bass starts and sustained cells from the existing Pattern; use pointer drag only to set an integer length on the start cell.
alternatives: Materialize a bass object in every sustained cell.
Add a second drag-state representation to Pattern.
tradeoffs: Deriving sustain cells preserves one persisted event per note and keeps playback/editor consistent.
The grid needs transient pointer state, but the Pattern remains immutable and overlap-safe.
seams: src/StepGrid.tsx and src/StepGrid.css own visual projection, 64-column geometry, and pointer gestures.
src/App.tsx owns audio audition and pattern updates through setBass/setBassLength/clearBass.
src/BassInspector.tsx supplies an accessible length fallback for non-pointer editing.
